description: Files whose names are not loadable locale tags, alongside a valid en. 'notes.txt' fails the tag grammar outright; 'zz' is well-formed but not a CLDR-known language; 'strings' is grammatically a language subtag but unknown — and is the exact stem that manifest-loads-json-extension-invalid-tag turns into a hard failure by appending .json; '.en-GB' is a valid tag hidden behind a leading dot. Verified: all four are skipped silently, with no warning and no failure.
